id.description: A permanent ID: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Never renamed or reused once published.

edtf.description: A date in EDTF, e.g. 1937-07-07, 1937-07, 1932~, -0220, 193X. See docs/data-format.md.

end.description: The first day on which this no longer applied (the date of the change), as EDTF; or 'ongoing' if it still applies; or 'unknown'.

wikidata.description: A Wikidata item ID, used as a cross-reference only.

citation.description: Where the claim comes from: a source ID and a locator (page, map sheet, feature ID, ...).

lang.description: A language tag (BCP 47), e.g. en, zh-Hant, ja. Use 'und' when the language isn't known.
